title: The dock · Rainier
logline: The dock at Gully's. Lukewarm Rainier. The strip's Chloe and Gully older. What she says is in a balloon; what Wood says is not drawn.

panels.composition: Gully's dock, late August, evening. CHLOE, forty-four, gray in the dark hair, the navy rain jacket, a can of Rainier. WOOD beside her, from behind — the back of the flannel. GULLY, heavy, no cap, at the shack door with a mug. The bird on a piling. One balloon on the page, hers. Wood's reply is not drawn; the space where it would be is left as dock planks.

characters.pose: on the dock edge with a can

balloons.text: Thirty years designing packaging for things nobody needed. And you sat here and drew the packaging. Give or take.

image.prompt: a wooden dock at evening: a woman in her forties with gray-streaked dark hair and a navy rain jacket holding a beer can, a man beside her seen only from behind in a plaid flannel, a heavyset older man in a fleece vest at a shingle shack's door with a mug, a small rainbow bird on a piling, one speech balloon, spare ink with slate and ochre watercolor, no panel borders
image.notes: Her balloon only. Wood's reply is deliberately absent — leave clean planks where it would go.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The brief's 2024 dock. What she says is drawn; what he says isn't. From behind.
